doc.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Why jazz is popular in Japan
summary: He thinks young Japanese treat jazz as fashion and few truly understand it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Why is jazz so popular in Japan? Do you know?

Oh I don’t know why, but young men like it as one of the fashion. Jazz is fashion. Many Japanese don’t understand jazz, but only fashion. But a few people really understand jazz music. Kind of music — Japanese like all kinds of music. Jazz is only one part. But younger generation like fashion.
